nodes.label: deviceAuth (scanner device) security scheme
nodes.rationale: Scanner devices authenticate with their own credential, separate from user JWTs.

nodes.label: Payment gateway fee
nodes.rationale: Payer may be CUSTOMER (added on top) or ORGANIZATION (deducted from payout); foreign cards may have a separate rate.

nodes.label: Idempotency-Key checkout header
nodes.rationale: Covers the itemIds selection; same key with other items is 409; prevents double charge/attach.

nodes.label: Cart item seat/ticket hold
nodes.rationale: Holds expire (410 on checkout); declined payment leaves cart and holds intact for retry.

nodes.label: AuditLogEntry schema
nodes.rationale: Immutable audit trail; mutability would defeat its purpose.

nodes.label: Cart schema
nodes.rationale: total = ticket price - promo discount + platform_fee + gateway_fee.

nodes.label: Category schema
nodes.rationale: Event category must match an active Category name case-insensitively, stored in canonical spelling.

nodes.label: CheckInConfig schema
nodes.rationale: standard vs pure_offline mode; warning surfaced if switching mode while devices may hold unsynced scans.

nodes.label: CheckoutStart schema
nodes.rationale: PayMongo async flow: clientKey is a per-payment secret never to be logged; order created only after webhook confirms.

nodes.label: POST /webhooks/paymongo
nodes.rationale: Public endpoint authenticated by Paymongo-Signature HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp.body; idempotent; bad signature is 401 and changes nothing.

nodes.label: Event schema
nodes.rationale: ticket_number_prefix is a random unique 3-letter code seeding Ticket.ticket_number only.

nodes.label: Event Ticketing API (OpenAPI 1.3.0-draft)
nodes.rationale: Target v1 marketplace design aligned to requirements.md, business-rules.md and use-cases.md v1.0; undecided items tracked in requirements.md section 7, not modeled here.

nodes.label: FinanceSummary schema
nodes.rationale: Platform-level finance: other currencies are excluded from figures; unknown gateway fees count 0.

nodes.label: GatewayFeeCheck schema
nodes.rationale: Compares configured gateway fee setting with real PayMongo fees on recent payments to suggest a corrected setting.

nodes.label: ModerationAction schema
nodes.rationale: BR-ADMIN-002; append-only, mirroring AuditLogEntry immutable-trail philosophy; previous_status lets REINSTATE restore exactly.

nodes.label: Money schema
nodes.rationale: Amounts stored as integer minor units with ISO 4217 currency to avoid floating-point money errors.

nodes.label: Order schema
nodes.rationale: platform_fee and gateway_fee are snapshotted at order time; later rule changes do not alter them. payee_type supports resale orders paid to a user.

nodes.label: Organization schema
nodes.rationale: Applications start pending and grant no privileges; only approved orgs gain an owner, publish events or receive payouts.

nodes.label: OrganizationMember schema
nodes.rationale: owner role cannot be assigned via members endpoint; only set by application approval.

nodes.label: Payment schema
nodes.rationale: Same shape whether the payee is the organizer or a reselling attendee.

nodes.label: PaymentMethod schema
nodes.rationale: Provider ids/tokens never returned; canChargeAgain false forces re-entry (409).

nodes.label: Payout schema
nodes.rationale: net = gross - fees; processing means transfer is with PayMongo and unsettled.

nodes.label: PayoutWallet schema
nodes.rationale: PayMongo wallet deactivated until Statement of Acceptance signed.

nodes.label: PlatformFeeRule schema
nodes.rationale: Most specific scope wins: EVENT, then ORGANIZATION, then PLATFORM. Flat part is per ticket so split payments cost the same.

nodes.label: Post schema
nodes.rationale: Public visibility derived from hidden flag, publishAt and expiresAt (status HIDDEN/EXPIRED/SCHEDULED/LIVE). imageUrl must be an own /uploads/files/ URL; replaced files deleted only if unreferenced elsewhere.

nodes.label: PromoCode schema
nodes.rationale: used_count (non-cancelled orders) decides whether code/discount type can change or the code can be deleted.

nodes.label: ResalePolicy schema
nodes.rationale: Organizer-controlled resale, disabled by default, with price cap rules (face_value, face_value_plus_fee, none).

nodes.label: ScannerDeviceWithCredential schema
nodes.rationale: Device credential shown once at creation and never again.

nodes.label: Ticket schema
nodes.rationale: ticket_number is human-visible and explicitly not a check-in credential.

nodes.label: TicketDataset schema
nodes.rationale: Prefetched credential hashes enable offline validation without exposing raw credentials.

nodes.label: TicketTemplate schema
nodes.rationale: Organizer-designed ticket layout; only own /uploads/files/ background images are drawn; QR or PDF417 barcode carry the same credential.

nodes.label: TicketTextField schema
nodes.rationale: Per-ticket keys vs event keys vs CUSTOM have different allowed members; event date/time rendered in event timezone.

nodes.label: TicketType schema
nodes.rationale: sales_paused blocks add-to-cart and checkout; position is organizer-defined ordering.

nodes.label: User schema
nodes.rationale: SUPER_ADMIN is a single un-grantable account; only it may create/demote/suspend ADMINs. Org roles (owner, organizer, check_in_staff) are combinable per organization.

nodes.label: Venue schema
nodes.rationale: Reusable org-owned location referenced by Event via venue_id; Event carries a read-time snapshot.

nodes.label: Offline / fallback check-in
nodes.rationale: pure_offline mode with a sole device and fallback recorder; duplicates flagged, not auto-resolved (requirements 4.11).

nodes.label: Own-uploads-only image URLs
nodes.rationale: Stored images must be this server's /uploads/files/ URLs; type detected from bytes, SVG rejected, 5 MB limit.
